name: week_start_date
description: Monday that opens the ISO week this row covers. Part of the grain.

name: store_id
description: Store that made the sales. Joins to AlloyDB stores.store_id. Part of the grain.

name: zip_code
description: ZIP of the selling store, denormalised from stores for query convenience. Functionally dependent on store_id; if the two ever disagree, stores is authoritative.

name: sku
description: Product sold. Joins to AlloyDB products.sku. Part of the grain.

name: units_sold
description: Units sold in the week. Reconciles exactly to the sum of SALE rows in AlloyDB stock_movements for the same store, SKU and complete week; the ledger and this table record the same events.

name: net_revenue
description: Revenue in USD after discounts and comps. NOT units_sold * products.unit_price: unit_price is the current list price, this is a historical figure, so the implied price is 92-100% of list.
